correctness.rationale: The scalar root is unique by strict monotonicity of a finite Fourier average and lies below sqrt(5)-2 by a positive root equation. The explicit positive-definite circulant shape satisfies every defining facet support equation by two inverse matrix entries; strictly positive facet multipliers sum to n and satisfy normalized first and second John contact moments, certifying global maximality and uniqueness. Fourier diagonalization, a roots-of-unity determinant identity and a factored root-gap equation give the volume and exact asymptotic constant. Finite standard-library tests verify n=5,...,31 but are not substituted for the general proof.

None of these papers logically covers the unique Euclidean inscribed John ellipsoid, its complete facet contacts and sharp exponential parameter law for odd-cycle FRAC polytopes. A previous exact circumsphere result is a non-implicative different optimization direction. This is a same-model literature comparison, not a complete historical priority certificate.

value.rationale: A complete closed-form geometric classification for every odd cycle provides a natural nontrivial continuous invariant of a standard combinatorial relaxation: unique center and shape, all contacts and their positive certificate, exact spectrum and determinant volume. The sharp exponential correction is a dimension-dependent refinement motivated by periodic cycle closure. It is not just a finite computation, an arbitrary slice, or a small normalization correction.
